The United States wants the world to believe it is a champion of freedom. But is America really in a position to lecture other countries?
A controversial post by the US Embassy in Australia, featuring the 2025 State of Global Freedom map, has triggered a backlash online. The map classifies the United States and Australia as 'Free', India and Pakistan as 'Partly Free', and China and Russia as 'Not Free'.
But the classifications raise uncomfortable questions. Is America defending universal values, or applying them selectively to serve its geopolitical interests?
